body: Architectural guidelines (Phase A): G-Skill-2 deviation — skills/review/SKILL.md's new review_run_id_valid guard reimplements run_log_batch.validate_run_id_slug's regex/glob check as inline Bash instead of calling a Python CLI helper (no run-log validate-* verb exists); the slug rule now lives in two places and can drift. Narrow scope, non-blocking.
